turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Elaine. Adrian Lim speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Adrian. I'm in my office with the door closed, so we can speak now. My afternoon is quite packed, but I've put a little time aside for this call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. Before we get into the call, may I have your identification details for our usual verification?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. While I have you, what arrangement would suit you best for future telephone appointments? We can avoid the periods when your office tends to be busiest.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Late mornings are usually better. Please send me a calendar invitation beforehand rather than calling unexpectedly. If my meetings move, I'll let your assistant know. Some days I barely get back to my desk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that preference for scheduling. A short appointment reminder can go through your usual contact channel as well. Have you managed to get any time in the garden recently?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A bit over the weekend, actually. I repotted the herbs and cleared a corner that had become very untidy. My basil is doing nicely, but the mint keeps spreading everywhere.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a pleasant break from the office. My mother keeps her mint in a separate pot for exactly that reason. Shall we turn to the purpose of your call now?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please. I've got my summaries open on the laptop. There are several windows here, so give me a moment to get myself organised.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: [[EV_009]] I'll leave a moment for you to get settled.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Just a moment, Elaine. I can hear some rustling at your end. There's no need to rush while you're looking through your papers.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time with the screen. I'll stay on the line while you find the page you need.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, I'll keep the appointment preference in your contact notes. Would you prefer that my assistant check your availability by message rather than ring your office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: By message, please. My receptionist is often handling visitors, and I don't want her trying to coordinate my diary as well. I'll respond myself when I'm between meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, that's helpful for arranging our next conversation. [[EV_007]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I hear you, Elaine. I'll let you attend to your visitor. Thank you for taking the call today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. Sorry, the office is a bit hectic this afternoon. I'll keep an eye out for your appointment message. Bye for now.
